title: almond-repro: code and sealed artefacts for 'Timing-Feasibility Constraints for LEO Handover'
description: Reproduction code, experiment scripts and the sealed JSON artefacts behind every number in the paper 'Timing-Feasibility Constraints for LEO Handover: Attribution, Calibration and Audit in a Digital Twin'. Includes the 350-satellite SGP4 twin, the censoring-aware miner, the deployed-policy probe, the counterfactual replay gate, the per-seed tables and the figure builders.
notes: The SGP4 twin cache (8.5 GB) and the trained checkpoints (303 MB) are not shipped; REPRODUCE.md gives the commands that rebuild them.
